policy: Every requirement is bound to a verbatim excerpt from the page named in source_roles. Nothing is inferred.
structure_note: This route rewards a work history rather than a qualification: seven months as a registered seasonal worker in the SAME industry within the last two years, plus A1 German and a binding permanent offer from that employer.
freshness_note: No dateline is published and the body mentions no year. Tracked by check-source-freshness as '[none published]', the same condition as Singapore's MOM and the US ESTA pages already live.

requirements.label: Seven months' registered seasonal work in the same industry within two years
requirements.description: Both the duration and the same-industry constraint are stated; a season in a different sector does not count.
requirements.source_excerpt: you have been employed for at least 7 months in the last two years as a registered regular seasonal worker in the same industry,
requirements.source_excerpt_display: you have been employed for at least 7 months in the last two years as a registered Regular Seasonal Worker in the same industry,

requirements.label: German at A1 level

requirements.label: A binding offer of permanent employment from that employer
